_comment: The ONE shard this install serves. Edit and reload — no rebuild needed. Field names must stay exactly as they are: the loader reads them by name and falls back to a default if one is misspelled, without reporting an error. In particular `slug` must be the same word as SHARD_SLUG in .env, the folder under gamefiles/, and the slug: in your servers/*.yaml — if it disagrees with the YAML the relay cannot resolve your shard and the client loads but never connects.
_clientVersion: UO client version reported to the server. Match what your shard expects.
_encrypt: none | old_bfish | blowfish_1_25_36 | blowfish | blowfish_2_0_3 | twofish_md5. Most modern free shards use none.
_gamefilesUrlBase: Path this client fetches your converted .mul files from, relative to the site root.
_externalGamefilesUrl: Optional absolute base if you host the gamefiles elsewhere (e.g. a CDN). Leave empty to use gamefilesUrlBase.
